subject: Request: Pilot credit top-up & extended POC window
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine@lumenishealth.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>
Cc: Lumenis Sales <sales@lumenishealth.com>
Date: 2028-08-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Pilot credit top-up & extended POC window

Hi Maya,

Really appreciate how responsive the Redwood team has been — we've made strong progress integrating the inference pipeline into our triage workflow, but ran into a few unexpected delays on our side that have consumed the PLG sandbox allotment faster than anticipated. Brief summary:
- Our data mapping team needed an extra 2 weeks to resolve anonymization edge cases.
- We underestimated token usage for multimodal transcript batching.

Given the delay, procurement is asking us to reduce risk before they sign the PO. To keep momentum, can Redwood provide an additional 200k free tokens and a 30-day extension to our pilot window? That runway will let us finish the integration tests and present a clean ROI package to procurement.

We can share our integration logs if that helps; attaching a small archive of the server-side traces we gathered yesterday.

Attachment: integration-log.zip (attachment stub)

Happy to hop on a quick call if helpful — we aim to have procurement engaged by mid-September.

Thanks,
Elaine Park
Head of Product Integrations
Lumenis Health

From: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@lumenishealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-08-25T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Pilot credit top-up & extended POC window

Thanks Elaine — appreciate the clear summary and the logs.

Short answer: we generally limit free sandbox/top-up credits on the PLG plan, but we do consider one-off exceptions when the customer shows clear progress to PO and there is a path to procurement. Before I loop in Deal Desk formally I have two quick asks:
1) Can you confirm projected token burn over the next 30 days (approx daily estimate)?
2) Who is the procurement contact and expected PO timeline if we grant this top-up?

I"ll loop in Marissa (Sales Ops / Deal Desk) and Aditya (SR leadership) to request a one-time approval. If they approve we'll send a short addendum that outlines the conversion terms and milestone.

Best,
Maya Srinivasan
Account Executive, Strategic Deals
Redwood Inference

Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>

Subject: RE: Request: Pilot credit top-up & extended POC window

Hi team — Marissa (Deal Desk) here. Quick summary and recommendation based on similar precedent:

Customer: Lumenis Health (DL-2028-487)
Request: +200k free tokens, +30 day pilot extension (beyond standard PLG sandbox limits)
Context: Integration delays caused by anonymization and multimodal batching; procurement engagement expected mid-September

Recommendation (one-off, conditional):
- Approve 150k complimentary tokens today, with the ability to grant the remaining 50k if the customer hits a technical milestone (successful end-to-end inference run with production dataset) within 21 days.
- Approve a 21-day extension to the pilot window (short of the requested 30d) — this is conservative but we can make it 30d with explicit milestone language.
- Terms: Credits expire at end of pilot; if customer converts to paid within 60 days, unused credits may be converted to invoice at 50% of list token rate (applied as a one-time credit).

Attached is a quick usage projection Elaine shared and a template addendum we use to capture the milestone.

Attachment: pilot-usage-projection.xlsx (attachment stub)

Need Aditya's signoff to proceed. If Aditya is good, I'll copy legal/finance for quick review and push the addendum to DocuSign.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-08-28T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Pilot credit top-up & extended POC window

Thanks for the tidy summary, Marissa.

Approve one-off: we will grant the full 200k complimentary tokens and a 30-day extension as requested. Two conditions:
1) Add explicit milestone language (E2E inference run on production-like sample) to trigger the second tranche if we choose to split the credit in the addendum.
2) Legal must sign off on the conversion clause; finance should acknowledge the accounting treatment if credits convert.

Jonas / Marissa — please coordinate legal/finance and update the addendum. Maya — you can send the approval note and DocuSign link to the customer once the addendum is ready.

Aditya Rao
Chief Revenue Officer
Redwood Inference

Subject: Approved: 200k complimentary tokens + 30-day pilot extension (next steps)

Hi Elaine — good news.

Redwood will approve the requested support to keep your pilot moving:
- 200,000 complimentary tokens applied to your sandbox account effective today.
- 30-day extension to the pilot window (new end date: 2028-09-29).

Conditions and next steps:
1) Milestone: We"ll define a short milestone (end-to-end inference run with production-like sample) in the addendum. Hitting that milestone will be documented and used for both internal reporting and to assess the remaining credit allotment if we opt to tranche the grant.
2) Conversion terms: If Lumenis converts to a paid contract within 60 days of pilot end, unused credits may be converted to invoice at a 50% list rate (one-time credit). This is the addendum that Marissa will route for legal/finance review.
3) DocuSign: Marissa will send the addendum via DocuSign; please have your procurement contact review and we"ll aim to keep signature turnaround under 5 business days.

Related links: https://hubspot.com/deal/DL-2028-487 | DocuSign to follow: https://docusign.com/templ/abcd-1234

Attachment: purchase-order-inbound-stub.pdf (attachment stub)

If you want to schedule a quick 30-minute sync to walk through the milestone check-list I can join. Congrats to the integration team — small lift to get live and procurement looks like the only remaining gating item.

Best regards,
Maya Srinivasan
Account Executive, Strategic Deals
Redwood Inference
